project.title: SD Standard at Abierto de Diseño
project.description: An exhibition installation introducing the SD Standard through physical objects, printed interpretation, and a supporting website.

components.name: Suspended lamp shade
components.description: A lightweight overhead element defining the exhibition space.

components.name: Display base
components.description: Modular base supporting the exhibition objects.
components.notes: Designed for reuse after the event.

components.name: Printed cards and posters
components.description: Visitor cards, criterion prompts, and event posters.
components.notes: Print quantities will follow daily attendance estimates.

components.name: Website
components.description: A lightweight companion page for visitors and remote audiences.

strategies.title: Define measurable event goals
strategies.description: Set targets for visitor engagement and follow-up learning.
strategies.notes: Goals agreed with the exhibition team.

criteriaAssessments.notes: Goals cover the full exhibition project.

strategies.title: Specify recycled paper
strategies.description: Select a locally available high-recycled-content stock.

criteriaAssessments.notes: Applies only to cards and posters.

strategies.title: Design for disassembly
strategies.description: Use reversible connections so parts can be separated after the exhibition.

strategies.title: Use permanent adhesive
strategies.description: Bond the display base for faster installation.
strategies.notes: Rejected because it prevents repair and material separation.

criteriaAssessments.notes: One shared assessment covers both fabricated components.

strategies.title: Optimize website assets
strategies.description: Compress images and avoid unnecessary scripts.

strategies.title: Test low-bandwidth access
strategies.description: Verify the page remains useful on constrained mobile connections.

criteriaAssessments.notes: Performance budget to be confirmed before launch.
Ink and printing finishes do not apply to the website component.

projectNotes: The exhibition should work as both a public introduction to the SD Standard and a practical test of reusable exhibition production methods.
